metric_definitions.ceremonial_syntax_density: Colon-terminated lines, em dashes, and formality-lexicon matches per 1,000 words.
metric_definitions.choice_list_self_similarity: Mean pairwise content-word Jaccard similarity among presented or recovered choices.
metric_definitions.choice_topic_recurrence: Content-word Jaccard similarity against presented or recovered choices in the preceding five playable turns.
metric_definitions.coinage_density: Title-Case multiword spans beginning mid-sentence per 1,000 words.
metric_definitions.dialogue_line_fraction: Fraction of non-empty lines containing a straight or curly double-quote character.
metric_definitions.lexical_novelty_rate: Fraction of the chunk's content-word types absent from all earlier chunks in the same channel series.
metric_definitions.mean_sentence_length: Mean alphabetic-word count per non-empty sentence or line segment.
